title: review
description: Payload of `stride review [week|YYYY-MM-DD]`: one Mon-Sun week. Measurements only; whether the week went well is the coach's call.

in_progress.description: true while today falls inside the week before its Sunday; actual totals then cover the days lived so far.

sessions.description: Every live planned session in the week (the rows `week` lists), in date order.

completed_activity_id.description: 0 when no activity completed the session.

substitute_activity_id.description: The activity done instead of a skipped session; 0 when none.

planned_load.description: The load the session's target prices to, by the rules `project` prices with; 0 when planned_load_known is false.

unprojected_reason.description: Why planned_load_known is false; empty when it is true. The reasons `project` lists under unprojected.

detected_known.description: True when the linked activity has detected power work segments. reps_delta and watts_pct are meaningful only when target_kind is power and detected_known is true; otherwise they ride at 0 behind the flags (ADR 0009).

reps_delta.description: detected_reps minus target_reps. A measurement, not a verdict (ADR 0012).

watts_pct.description: detected_mean_watts as a percentage of target_watts.

target_known.description: True when this session carries a structured target on any signal (ADR 0014, ADR 0019); target_kind names the signal. Every magnitude is an impossible-zero field behind this flag (ADR 0009), and a magnitude another kind carries stays 0 or the empty string.

target_kind.description: The signal the target is written on: power watts, a heart-rate band, an HR zone, a pace, or a session rating (RPE). Empty when target_known is false.

target_literal.description: The target in its canonical spelling, e.g. 3x12:00@230W, 1x1:00:00@HR125-147, 1x1:30:00@Z2, 5x4:00@4:10/km, 10x100m@1:40/100m. Empty when target_known is false.

target_dur_s.description: A timed rep's length in seconds; 0 for a distance rep.

target_dist_m.description: A distance rep's length in metres; 0 for a timed rep. Only a pace target carries one.

target_hr_lo.description: The heart-rate band's floor in bpm; hr targets only.

target_hr_hi.description: The heart-rate band's cap in bpm; hr targets only.

target_zone.description: The HR zone, 1-5, under the athlete's configured zones; zone targets only.

target_pace_s.description: Seconds per target_pace_unit; pace targets only.

target_pace_unit.description: The distance a pace reads over; pace targets only.

exec_known.description: True when the linked activity carries the target's own signal to compare: detected power work for power, an HR stream for hr, a zone split for zone, pace reps or a distance for pace. The kind's execution fields are meaningful only when this is true; otherwise they ride at 0 or empty (ADR 0009).

exec_reason.description: Why exec_known is false; empty when it is true. pace_unit_mismatch: the activity's sport family is not one the target's pace unit is read over (/km and /mi: run, walk and hike; /100m: swim; /500m: rowing). no_rating: an rpe target whose activity has no rating yet (stride rate). not_done: the session has no linked activity (open, skipped, or completed without one), so there is nothing to measure.

hr_under_s.description: hr targets: seconds below the band's floor.

hr_in_s.description: hr targets: seconds inside the band, floor and cap included.

hr_over_s.description: hr targets: seconds above the band's cap.

hr_mean.description: hr targets: the mean of the stream's valid (35-220 bpm) HR samples, in bpm.

zone_below_s.description: zone targets: seconds in the zones below the target zone, from the zone split analyze stored for the activity.

zone_in_s.description: zone targets: seconds in the target zone.

zone_above_s.description: zone targets: seconds in the zones above the target zone.

pace_basis.description: pace targets: detected when the interval detector found pace work reps, whole when it did not. Both report the ACTUAL pace: on detected, the distance the stream covered inside the reps' windows over their time (the detector's own signal is grade-adjusted, so its average is not used); on whole, distance over moving time.

pace_actual_s.description: pace targets: the actual pace in seconds per target_pace_unit, on the basis pace_basis names.

pace_pct.description: pace targets: target_pace_s as a percentage of pace_actual_s, i.e. the execution's speed relative to the target's; above 100 is faster than the target.

pace_reps.description: pace targets: the detected pace work reps; 0 on the whole basis.

pace_reps_delta.description: pace targets: pace_reps minus target_reps on the detected basis; 0 otherwise. A measurement, not a verdict (ADR 0012).

target_rpe.description: The session rating the target names, 1-10; rpe targets only.

rpe_actual.description: The activity's stored session rating; behind rpe_known (ADR 0009 impossible-zero: a rating is 1-10).

rpe_known.description: True when the target is an rpe one and the activity carries a rating; rpe_actual is a measurement only then.

execution.description: How the session went on its target's own signal: the fields `complete` reports, measured against the linked activity.

unplanned.description: Activities in the week no planned session claims, as completion or as substitute: the rows `week` lists as unlinked.

load.description: Read through load_model: 0 under an empty or none model is unscored, not a measured zero.

planned_load.description: The summed planned_load of the day's priced sessions.

actual_load.description: The day's load from daily_load; 0 when actual_known is false.

actual_known.description: false for a day analyze has not reached: a day still ahead, or today before analyze runs.

actual_total.description: The sum over the days with actual_known.

sessions_priced.description: Sessions whose planned_load is known; the gap to sessions_planned is how much of the plan planned_total cannot see.

polarization_known.description: true when the week's polarized activities hold any intensity seconds; the six fields above cover only those activities (the activity_intensity view `summary` and `compare` read) and are measurements only then.

hard_days.description: Distinct days holding a session with 5+ hard minutes: summary's hard-day rule.

hard_spacing_median_days.description: Median gap between hard_days; 0 when hard_spacing_known is false.

hard_spacing_known.description: false with fewer than two hard days.

sports.description: One row per sport family with an activity in the week, most sessions first.

family.description: The stored sport_family: a family's first sport type, or the sport type itself outside every family.

without_sets.description: Strength-family activities with no stored sets; `strength import` or a description paste adds them.

awaiting_rating.description: Strength-class activities (lifting, HIIT, yoga, pilates and the like) with no rating; `stride rate` scores them.

known.description: false when daily_load holds no row for the Sunday before the week; the magnitudes are then 0.

day.description: The row read: the week's latest analyzed day up to Sunday, or today in a week still running.

known.description: false when daily_load holds no row inside the week yet; the magnitudes are then 0.
